description: Address format and postal code validation for 252 countries: postcode regex and examples, PIN code (India), ZIP and postal code names, address line order, required fields, and states or provinces with ISO 3166-2 codes. Covers all 54 African countries (says which have no postcodes), India, the Gulf and Asia. Pass postcode to check it; India PIN codes also return the state. Source: Google's open address metadata (Apache 2.0). Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country codes, comma-separated, up to 60 (default: all 252 countries and territories)

postcode.description: Optional postcode or PIN code to check against the format; needs exactly one country

name: address_format_lookup
title: Address format and postal code validation (252 countries, incl. all of Africa and India PIN codes)
